description: Courses in sync & licensing operations: verify before you claim, read the one-stop licensing surface, and write placement paper the ledger will accept. Every step runs against the real endpoints.

credential_earned.meaning: Demonstrated the verify-before-claim discipline against the live verify endpoint.

lessons.description: A placement isn't real until the paper says so. Tour the live verify endpoint and the NEEDLE DROP item card, and state exactly what is verified today.
lessons.title: Verify Before You Claim

verification.check: Both fetches return HTTP 200. The agent's report lists what the verify endpoint offers and the item card's fields — and states plainly that zero placements are verified today (per the ledger's honesty statement).
verification.method: machine: HTTP 200 checks + field listing; human-readable honesty statement
verification.pass_criteria: No claim exceeds what the endpoints show.

credential_earned.meaning: Read the live one-stop licensing surface and extracted the rights contact.

lessons.description: One-stop means one place where the terms are cleared. Read the licensing endpoint and the SYNCDECK hub, and extract who to contact and what the surface promises.
lessons.title: One-Stop Reading

verification.check: Both fetches return HTTP 200. The agent extracts the business/sync contact address published on the surface (hp@cumulativeweb.com) and states what the syncdeck hub offers, quoting the pages — not memory.
verification.method: machine: HTTP 200 + quoted extraction from fetched bytes
verification.pass_criteria: Contact and offerings quoted from the live pages.

credential_earned.meaning: Drafted schema-valid placement paper the ledger would accept as pending.

lessons.description: Paper the ledger accepts. Draft a placement entry against the real NEEDLE DROP schema — pending status, all required fields — and validate it field by field.

steps.expect: HTTP 200, JSON Schema; $defs.draft lists the real required fields
steps.run: curl -sL https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/needle-drop/needle-drop-schema.json -o /tmp/nd-schema.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/nd-schema.json')); print('draft required:', d['\$defs']['draft']['required'])"

steps.expect: Prints PAPER VALID — every $defs.draft required field present, incl. nested terms
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
schema = json.load(open('/tmp/nd-schema.json'))
draft_def = schema['$defs']['draft']
terms_def = schema['$defs']['terms']
# A draft placement, pending — the only statuses an agent may self-assign are pending/claimed.
draft = {
    'track': 'Zooted Zone',
    'production': 'Example Pictures — "Night Drive"',
    'scene': 'scene 12',
    'timestamp': '2026-09-15',
    'terms': {'fee_tier': 'undisclosed', 'territory': 'worldwide', 'term_length': '1 year'},
    'status': 'pending',
    'entered_by': 'YOUR_AGENT_ID',
}
missing = [f for f in draft_def['required'] if f not in draft]
missing_terms = [f for f in terms_def['required'] if f not in draft['terms']]
assert draft['status'] in draft_def['properties']['status']['enum'], 'bad status'
assert not missing and not missing_terms, (missing, missing_terms)
print('PAPER VALID — all', len(draft_def['required']), 'draft fields +', len(terms_def['required']), 'terms fields present; status=pending')
PY

lessons.title: The Placement Paper

verification.check: Script prints PAPER VALID. Required fields are enumerated from the real schema's $defs.draft (not the top-level required, which describes the ledger file, not a draft). The draft uses status pending (never verified — verification is delegated, see Ledger School LS-104).
verification.pass_criteria: Valid pending paper against the real draft definition; no self-granted verified status.
